input.command:
python3 -c '
# Triangulate Chair 2 from obs 83 and obs 84
# obs 83: X = 0.7312, heading = 270 deg
# obs 84: X = 0.2312, heading = 270 deg
import cv2, numpy as np

img84 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0084.png")
mask84 = (img84[:,:,2] > 90) & (img84[:,:,2] < 160) & (img84[:,:,1] > 40) & (img84[:,:,1] < 80) & (img84[:,:,0] < 40)

# Chair 2 in obs 84:
ys2, xs2 = np.where(mask84[:, 150:260])
xs2 += 150
print(f"Chair 2 in obs 84: x=[{xs2.min()}, {xs2.max()}], width={xs2.max()-xs2.min()+1}, bottom_y={ys2.max()}")

# In obs 83: width was 245 - 182 + 1 = 64
# In obs 84: width is:
w83 = 64.0
w84 = float(xs2.max() - xs2.min() + 1)
# Delta X = 0.5 m
# d84 = Delta X / (w84 / w83 - 1)
d84 = 0.5 / (w84 / w83 - 1)
d83 = d84 + 0.5
print(f"Pure parallax depth d83 = {d83:.4f} m, d84 = {d84:.4f} m")
print(f"Chair 2 X: {0.2312 - d84:.4f} m")
'
